findings.summary: Self-gate is not wired into the production default path. run_self_gate() (graphs/runner.py:477) returns None unless LineConfig.dd_awaiting_gate_development_id is set, but nothing ever sets it: cli.py _line_run builds LineConfig without the field (cli.py:158), scheduler/launcher.py LaunchSpec has no dd-awaiting-gate field and argv() never passes one, and scheduler/ignition.py decide() re-ignites a dd_awaiting_gate-woken line as an ordinary run. The dd_awaiting_gate wake only clears the park (daemon.py:_wake); the line then boots with an empty wake id, so deliver_self_gate_decision is never invoked and decided_by = line principal never occurs. This is precisely the exported-but-never-invoked defect the spec (item 7 line 30, item 8) forbids.

The six evidence obligations are never mechanically produced in production. evidence_acceptance_frozen / evidence_diff_within_scope / evidence_zero_test_deletion / evidence_personally_rerun / evidence_regression / enumerate_mutation_targets have no production callers (grep shows only their definitions in dd/self_gate.py plus tests/test_m3_line_selfgate.py), and run_self_gate passes evidence=evidence or [] (runner.py:482), so even if the wake id were wired the delivery would refuse on missing obligation rather than collect real acceptance argv / diff / test-deletion / rerun / mutation-receipt / regression baseline.
